principle: Do not let task success compensate for unauthorized mutations, wrong-subject access, invalid provenance, failed independent replay, or uncontained failure.
rules: Match task version, inputs, environment, agent/tool access, network policy, and compute/time budgets.
Publish raw capability and qualified success separately.
Publish category results, paired task-level deltas, confidence intervals, cost and energy per qualified success.
Pin the external benchmark revision; never carry scores between revisions.
Every task must pass with a reference and fail with a no-op before admission.

comparators: SWE-Bench Pro V2: 642 tasks; hidden fail-to-pass/pass-to-pass tests; pristine-image regrade
SWE Atlas: 124 Codebase Q&A, 90 Test Writing, 70 Refactoring
Terminal-Bench 2.1: 89-task corrected revision; resolution, tokens, cost
METR Time Horizon 1.1: reliability versus human-expert task duration

targets.foundation: 100% task reference-pass/no-op-fail; exact source, environment, tool and verifier digests on each claimed success.
targets.competitive: Within 5 percentage points of the strongest matched baseline at equal budgets, with no weaker integrity or replay gates.
targets.stretch: Statistically supported held-out improvement in qualified resolve rate and at least 20% lower cost per qualified fix.

comparators: HealthAgentBench V2: 75 tasks, 9 categories; 57.3% highest listed pooled success snapshot
HL7 FHIR R4 resource/profile validation plus server behavior tests

targets.foundation: 100% correct identity/authority handling in deterministic controls; zero observed unauthorized mutations across at least 10,000 adversarial episodes, stratified by threat family.
targets.competitive: Claim direct HealthAgentBench comparison only after reproducing its full 75-task environment; otherwise compare the narrower EHR categories separately.
targets.stretch: Lower harm-weighted selective risk at equal coverage and at least 20% lower cost per qualified workflow.

comparators: ASME V&V 20: specified validation points with numerical and experimental uncertainty
ASME VVUQ 20.1-2024: multivariate discrepancies and shared/independent uncertainty
Rapier/Jolt/Box2D: matched release-build scenes, correctness and p50/p95/p99 latency

targets.foundation: Zero classification errors on each frozen independent seed; exact replay on deterministic profiles and declared numeric tolerances elsewhere.
targets.competitive: On matched 2D/3D scenes, first match correctness/stability, then target p95 tick latency within 10% of the strongest matched comparator.
targets.stretch: Zero reference-classification errors on a preregistered 100,000-pair stratified 4D holdout without reducing determinism coverage.

comparators: W3C Verifiable Credentials and Data Integrity lifecycle tests
Pinned Holochain conductor, HDK/HDI validation and countersigning behavior

targets.foundation: 100% correct deterministic lifecycle controls; unresolved commit/delivery stays unresolved until recipient-side evidence.
targets.competitive: Compare throughput only under matched topology, persistence, replication and fault models; report safety invariants separately.
targets.stretch: At least 10,000 episodes per threat family with zero observed invariant violations and cluster-aware uncertainty.

statistics.zero_failure_interpretation: Zero observed failures is not zero risk. For n independent trials, approximate 95% upper bound is 3/n; use cluster-aware intervals for shared scenarios.
